attempts.result: Incorrect archive-length/type interpretation and blanket CRC-failure claim are superseded. They were not evidence of an irrecoverable format.

Treating the old length word as archive extent failed XML parsing; using standard 30-byte local headers failed filename decoding. A guessed standard directory-prefix layout was also refused. Measured 16/28/40-byte framing corrected these interpretations.
Seven inventories completed before the eighth source exposed a zero-filled directory. It is retained as missing structure, not discarded or repaired.

Initially over-narrow decimal-only internal names and an XML-footer extent excluding three whitespace bytes were refused. Hexadecimal names and measured footer-inclusive whitespace extents were incorporated before the final run.
An initial negative test removed only an optional final newline and incorrectly expected refusal. It now preserves that valid variant and tests an actually truncated numeric footer instead.

public_sources.use: Public ZIP local/central/CRC baseline only; TEB deviations are independently observed bytes.
Fresh fetch failed; existing pinned installer/image remains the measured viewer, not a new vendor-download claim.

remaining: Actual declared-PDF wrapping, key derivation and validated credential requirements are unestablished; no endpoint was contacted and no credential supplied.
The eight complete container CRCs verify stored bytes, not plaintext PDF content, authored page count, geometry, outlines or recoverability.
The damaged attachment needs missing bytes or a separate intact edition; its prefix-matching catalog candidate is not silently substituted.
Stable error screenshots do not resolve #441 or prove that network access alone would make any protected source readable.
